title: RecoveryBundle
description:
`issuer.bundle` data: a file written only by the CLI (§5 "RecoveryBundle").
Never a private key, a passphrase or a socket path.

foreign_removals.description:
⟨ADR-0008 §17.27 item 1; additive⟩ The foreign removals that are not final, by
their public removal descriptors. Absent when there are none (an older bundle
decodes and re-encodes unchanged).

AccountName.description: Remote account name on a destination.

BundleCa.description: One CA in a recovery bundle.

BundleEnrollment.description: One enrollment in a recovery bundle (public metadata).

destination_id.description: The writing installation's destination ID (a label elsewhere).

hostname.description: Hostname; absent in a redacted bundle.

port.description: Port; absent in a redacted bundle.

registry.description: The canonical registry (what foreign removal uses).

registry_path_display.description: For people only; never parsed back.

BundleForeignRemoval.description:
⟨ADR-0008 §17.27 item 1 (W5-R01)⟩ One foreign removal that is not final, in a
recovery bundle: its **public removal descriptor** only (the fields of
[`crate::enrollment::ForeignRemovalTarget`], hostname and port omitted when
redacted) and its state. Never foreign bytes (W4-S02): no remote line, no
journal content; the line is identified by `line_sha256` alone.

bundle_destination_id.description: The source bundle's destination ID: a label only.

hostname.description: Hostname; absent in a redacted bundle.

local_alias.description: This device's managed alias for the host.

port.description: Port; absent in a redacted bundle.

BundleLateWrite.description: A bundle enrollment's `late_write` residual: the remote not-after only.

not_after_remote.description: Remote epoch seconds after which a late script fails its own check.

CaFingerprint.description:
⟨M03⟩ A CA public key's fingerprint: `SHA256:` followed by exactly 43 characters
of unpadded standard base64 (`A-Za-z0-9+/`), as `ssh-keygen -l` prints it
(m03-plan §5 item 1). Validated on parse and on decode; compared exactly.

CaState.description:
A CA's state (ADR-0008 D4 item 3). Transitions:
`heimdall_domain::issuance::ca_transition`.

oneOf.description:
Rotation's new CA before its first verified enrollment; signs only
verification certificates for its own enrollments.
Issues for pairs it has a verified enrollment for.
Issuance disabled; the key is being unloaded.
No process holds the key.
The store item is gone.
Final.
A `cert-authority` line in the account's registry (the default).
`TrustedUserCAKeys` plus `AuthorizedPrincipalsFile`, applied by the owner.

EnrollmentState.description:
The enrollment record's state (ADR-0008 D5 §6.2; revision 2's 20 states). The
allowed transitions are `heimdall_domain::enrollment::transition`.

oneOf.description: Operation admitted, awaiting the owner decision.
The approved operation is running; nothing remote is known written.
The append may or may not have applied.
Our marker or trust is present but wrong, or a check needs the owner.
The exact line is present; no verification has passed yet.
System form: waiting for the owner to apply the sshd lines.
The initial verification is running.
Positive passed and negative refused with full evidence.
A later verification is running; never removes anything.
The initial verification failed; removing our line under the decision.
The rollback's removal may or may not have applied (rollback purpose).
An explicit owner-decided removal is running.
The explicit removal may or may not have applied (removal purpose).
System form: the owner is to remove the sshd lines.
System form: the absence check runs.
Final: the rollback removed our line.
Final: removed (system form: absence verified).
Final: nothing of ours remains as last observed.
Final: refused before any write.
The owner gave the account up; trust may remain (`pending_until_line_removed`).

RegistryCanonical.description:
The canonical registry the bundle and foreign removal carry: the validated path
(absent for `remote_home`), never a display form (ADR-0008 D4 item 5).

RegistryResolvedBy.description: How a registry path was resolved (ADR-0008 D5 §6.1).

oneOf.description: Given explicitly (`--registry-path`).
`$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys` on the remote.
